g.title: None.None.Node.26
g.text: Users resolve the application in Route 53, which health-checks both regions
While us-east-1 is healthy, Route 53 answers with its load balancers
ECS Fargate tasks handle the request
The tasks write to the Aurora primary cluster
and store sessions in DynamoDB through the gateway endpoint
Aurora Global Database replicates the data to eu-west-1
DynamoDB global tables copy the sessions
S3 cross-region replication copies the assets
When the health checks fail, Route 53 sends users to eu-west-1 and Aurora is promoted there
